rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating manner as previously described
relative pronoun referring to the agent
verb denoting the act of carrying out the ritual
ritual installation or establishment as object of the action
compound describing the agent's meditative qualification; bhāvanā+āyuta

items.question: What qualifies a mortal to perform the consecration in the prescribed manner?
premises: A mortal may perform the consecration in this manner.
The prescribed manner follows the previously stated ritual procedure.
The performing mortal is endowed with contemplative absorption.
items.inference: A mortal endowed with contemplative absorption is the one who properly performs the consecration in this prescribed manner.
items.plain_english: Thus, the mortal who, endowed with contemplative absorption, performs the consecration in this way.
